_about: Public-domain Michael Wigglesworth (1631-1705), minister of Malden, Massachusetts, and New England's Puritan poet, for the Word Hoard: The Day of Doom with other poems (1867 reprint of the 1715 edition) and Meat out of the Eater (1689), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 51 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wigglesworth-day-of-doom: The day of doom (New York, American news company, 1867)

_alternates.wigglesworth-copies: The 1666, 1673 and 1687 London printings of The Day of Doom (Early English Books), the 1711 Boston printing, other 1867 copies, and the Gutenberg text (PG 56053)
